verdict.rationale: Alloy's docs index lists first-party pages on retroactively assigning an External Entity ID, supporting multiple External Entity IDs, and entity merging. That points to a native way to reconcile customer (entity) records against stable external identifiers. The evidence is only index titles with no detail, and nothing shows external identifiers for case or investigation records. Missing for 10: documented detail of external-ID behavior and lookup semantics, external-ID support for case/investigation records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
